title: issue.reveal_decided
description: The reporter allowed or refused fields (`decideIssueReveal`). `node_id` of the entry is the issue node. The actor is the app the report came from (kind `app`), with `on_behalf_of` null: the reporter is a pairwise pseudonym, not a principal. Field names and choices only, never values. This schema is the `data` of a journal entry with `type` `issue.reveal_decided`. Step 3, planned (decision 0004-21, docs/STEP3.md).
